notes: g2mrg-format-arms writes the §2002:14.8.23.1 MERGE arms: the KEY phrases, every COLLATING SEQUENCE form (IS alphabet-name-1 alone, IS alphabet-name-1 alphabet-name-2, FOR ALPHANUMERIC alone, FOR NATIONAL alone, and both choice-indicator alternatives in reverse order), GIVING one and two files, and OUTPUT PROCEDURE with THROUGH and THRU (without THRU: g2mrg01-merge-anywhere-but-declaratives). The merge order is derived from §2002:14.8.23.3 GR3-GR5 and a literal alphabet, and the case printed the eight derived lines at --std 2002 on the pinned build.
